capture_requirements: Record each actual covergroup .sample() invocation inside its sampling branch, including simulation time, sequence index and all arguments.
Record AON clock edges and enable/update/reset/sleep events, so startup delay and same-edge ordering can be measured.
Use identical explicit stimuli and recorded clock/reset settings in the UVM and Cocotb short runs; do not equate random seed numbers across frameworks.
Distinguish control-event messages from actual sample calls; explicitly compare same-time count/expiry behavior.
Compare sample tuples, ordering and timing with a documented clock-domain alignment; preserve mismatches and unknowns.
Retain source/build/tool hashes, testcase, seed, exact parameters, process exit status and zero-error/fatal summaries for both runs.
remaining_scope: Timer startup/count/expiry, updates, restart, prescale, sleep/pause and reset semantics.
Interrupt fields, pin transitions and shared/non-AON sample sites.
Legacy exact identity mapping, exact Stage 06 vectors and paper Stage 07 scheduler.
